issue.body:
## Problem

`isAllowedHost(host)` throws when `allowlist.txt` is missing, and the install command crashes with a stack trace.

## Fix

Catch the read error. When the allowlist is missing or unreadable, deny every host: `isAllowedHost` returns `false` and logs one warning naming the file. Never allow a host the list was not read for.

## Done when

- [ ] A missing or unreadable allowlist denies every host and warns.
- [ ] A test covers the missing-file case.

pr.title: fix(sample-kit): stop crashing when the allowlist is missing
pr.body: Catches the allowlist read error and warns instead of crashing, with a test.
